research_rule: Математика не сходится. Пока не сойдется.
hypothesis: A wide supplied boundary can still admit a compact exact replayable message when GF2/Horn/signed-2SAT fragments share internal variables, provided the composition engine discovers a joint symbolic elimination rather than relying on disjoint-module factorization or 2^k boundary enumeration.
scientific_target: Test whether compact boundary messages survive internal-variable entanglement. This gate does not establish arbitrary-CNF polynomial projection or P=NP.
forbidden_shortcuts: No explicit enumeration of 2^k boundary assignments in the solver path.
No family or generator label may be supplied to the solver.
No projector may be given the hidden construction recipe.
No decomposition that assumes pairwise-disjoint internal variable sets may be treated as sufficient.
No exponential cost may be hidden in certificate discovery, canonicalization, Proof DAG nodes, join work, or serialization.
Learning may reorder candidate transforms but may not prune exact fallback scope.
Same-case evidence may not promote the policy that selected the same case.

gates.E1_EXACTNESS_AND_REPLAY: 100% successful cases must independently replay and match evaluation audit.
gates.E2_INTERNAL_ENTANGLEMENT_REAL: 100% holdout cases must have at least one internal variable shared across different typed fragments, and clean disjoint-module decomposition must be unavailable.
gates.E3_NO_WHOLE_LANGUAGE_SHORTCUT: No single base projector may accept the entire mixed-entangled component.
gates.E5_COMPACT_MESSAGE: For k>=8, median message_atoms/2^k <= 0.20 and max <= 0.35.
gates.E6_NO_MEASURED_EXPONENTIAL_MIGRATION: On the frozen k ladder, median paid_nohide_metric, serialized bytes, DAG nodes and join/elimination ops must not exhibit super-quadratic doubling ratios between adjacent k steps; this is a finite empirical gate, not a theorem.
gates.E7_DISCOVERY_WITHOUT_ORACLE: At least 80% of cases must produce an exact compact message without family/generator labels.
gates.E8_RBLGANUL_GOVERNANCE: TruthGate/ProofPack authority only, next-epoch learning, protected challenger exposure nonzero.
gates.E9_UNIVERSAL_POLYNOMIAL_BOUNDARY_ELIMINA: Must remain OPEN unless an arbitrary-CNF proof and formal polynomial bounds are produced.
